verdict.rationale: RudderStack is a CDP with pipelines, transformations, and an MCP server for AI-assisted management, but there is no evidence of autonomous background automations/agents that run independently to take actions without human-triggered pipelines — the MCP tools described are interactive assistants (chat, Slack bot, natural-language debugging), not self-running background automations. missing for 10: evidence of autonomous scheduled/triggered agentic workflows running without user interaction, evidence of agent-initiated actions rather than user-prompted queries.
